name: stage2_main
_comment: FORMAL STAGE 2. 454 train images, 30 epochs, lr 3e-4. Model selection is
val-only and uses the frozen rule: a node may be promoted only if BOTH val
MA IoU and val HE IoU of the ASSEMBLED full-image map improve on the
champion. No per-class threshold tuning, no candidate-threshold re-scan,
no test access, no early stopping on the basis of a bad-looking curve.
checkpoint_nodes = the PRE-REGISTERED validation nodes (every 5 epochs, 6
evaluations, exactly the budget in GO_NO_GO.md R8). They are declared here
before the first epoch and are never added to or removed afterwards.
The loss block below is a verbatim mirror of configs/refiner_v1.json;
refiner.losses.assert_frozen_objective fails closed on any drift.

stage2_main.select_on: val MA IoU AND HE IoU of the assembled map
stage2_main.select_rule: keep the checkpoint only if both classes improve
